{"task": {"role": "You read the description of an outfit and list its items as data.", "rules": ["One object per item — garment, shoes, bag, accessory, jewelry — in the order of the description, with its words and hex.", "One item carries one thing — of two alternatives list the first; a note in brackets is not an item.", "Slot "accessory" is for an item no other slot fits.", ""is_outfit" says whether the description is an outfit: no — when in place of items it has a refusal, a question or a note."], "limits": ["Rely only on the input: do not invent what it does not contain.", "The answer is one JSON object following "answer_schema", without explanations and without ```."], "language": "English", "answer": "ITEM_LIST", "answer_schema": {"is_outfit": "yes|no", "items": [{"name": "<what the item is>", "details": "<its cut, length and fabric>", "slot": "top|bottom|dress|set|outerwear|shoes|bag|scarf|headwear|belt|tights|socks|jewelry|earrings|collar_necklace|necklace|brooch|bracelet|ring|glasses|gloves|watch|swimwear|underwear|accessory", "color_hex": "<#rrggbb or null>", "worn": "<true, or false when the description says the outfit goes without it>"}]}, "input": [""description" — the outfit description"]}, "description": "Red silk blouse with a relaxed fit, knee-length, vibrant crimson (hex #D40000), lightweight woven fabric.
High-waisted tailored trousers in a matching deep red tone, full length, rich burgundy (hex #800020), heavy wool blend.
Strapless ankle boots in polished leather, mid-calf height, deep wine color (hex #4A0404).

This outfit works because it respects her specific wish for something red while adapting the formal level from casual loungewear to a neat, date-appropriate look suitable for walking in an autumn park. The choice of matching tones creates a cohesive and sophisticated silhouette that elevates the occasion beyond basic home wear without becoming overly stiff or formal. Finally, the relaxed cut of the blouse paired with tailored trousers balances comfort with style, making it perfect for a Sunday coffee date under daylight."}
